* '''Playtest''' (this page, 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-ahchtocliffs-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/ahchtocliffs.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Once per turn, may search Reserve Deck. Take one Jedi Test into hand. Reshuffle deck.” Dark Side: “You may use 1 Force to cancel any Force drain here.” The title strips print “•DAGOBAH: TRAINING AREA”. This Playtest image is a picture of the underlying Decipher card [[Dagobah: Training Area]], published under this card's file name the day before release.
* '''Original''' ([[Ahch-To: Cliffs]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-ahchtocliffs-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/ahchtocliffs.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “If Luke here or out of play, Force Projection is [Immune to Sense].” Dark Side: “While Luke here, attrition against you everywhere is +1.” '''What changed:''' before release: the picture of the Decipher card Dagobah: Training Area was replaced by this card (title “•AHCH-TO: CLIFFS”, new artwork, new game text, lower-left margin “Dagobah: Training Area”).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Ahch-To: Cliffs (Errata)]], 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-L-ahchtocliffs.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/hires/ahchtocliffs.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “If Luke here or out of play, Force Projection is [Immune to Sense].” Dark Side: “While Luke here, attrition against you everywhere is +1.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words; re-rendered at high resolution (the credit line now reads “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”).
